prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity 1440x900 landscape desktop app screen for SoloDesk, rendered edge to edge, crisp readable text, no external browser frame or physical desk. The attached image is the supplied SoloDesk logo mark only; preserve its identity where it appears, not its background or scale. SoloDesk helps freelance engineers and small teams manage delivery, time and invoices. Jade Wayfinding uses flat silver and white reading surfaces, graphite lettering, and deep jade #126A56 for current context and primary actions. Its multilingual civic wayfinding influence means clear labels, generous whitespace and a context-and-next-action header; standard app controls, no signs or maps. Project work leads. Show a large project table under filters and a sidebar, with a context strip connecting Scope, Work, Time and Billing. Include SoloDesk branding, workspace 'Studio', navigation Overview, My work, Projects, Clients, Time, Finance, Reports; global search, timer 00:42:18 and sync status. Main real illustrative work rows: 'Review API contract' / Atlas API / In review / Today; 'Prepare release checklist' / Client platform / In progress / Tomorrow; 'Confirm onboarding access' / New client / Blocked / 19 Oct. Include 'New task', clear table headings, one unobtrusive 'Working offline — changes save on this device; invoice issuance requires a connection' banner, and small 'Illustrative data' label. Spacious controls and generous row heights, familiar native-style buttons and menus. Use the first viewport and enough lower content to prove a full working screen. No decorative charts, giant revenue claims, gradient text, ornamental textures, or tiny unreadable type.
